analysis.assessment: Source-format robustness of the newly ingested package (twelve XLSX sources, twenty-four cultivation runs, first available at the 2026-10-18 cutoff with no calendar timestamps) is high for schema parsing and identity resolution, and weak in clock semantics and placeholder records. Identities are fully resolved: twenty-four runs map one-to-one to sources with zero unlinked observations and no alias spellings; the '_batch'/'_fed-batch' file naming describes cultivation mode, not manufacturing batch identity. Units are structurally consistent (each column name carries exactly one unit string across all sources), but four column families carry no unit, capacitance columns carry probe-frequency strings as units, and turbidity/fit-statistic columns carry arbitrary or statistic labels, blocking automatic unit conversion. Duplicate handling is confined to EXP004: both runs rewind the elapsed-time clock by approximately one hour (certified metric exp004-r01-clock-rewind-h) and record the same window twice with different measured values (one hundred twenty duplicated time values per affected series), so neither copy can be dropped without an explicit policy and no calendar timestamps exist to arbitrate. Backwards clock steps are broader (thirteen of the twenty-four runs): representative cell-level verification shows isolated single-tick transpositions in EXP002/R02 (nine steps), EXP007/R02 (one step), EXP001/R01, EXP002/R01, EXP007/R01, EXP009/R02 and EXP012/R02, and a sustained reversed clock segment in EXP003/R01 (rows spanning the reversed segment cited), so source-row order must never be treated as chronological. Irrelevant-or-misleading records: categorical Status text ('Ok' sampled; no Warning/Error/Offline found) is excluded from the numeric projection; twenty-two permittivity-derived columns are zero-filled for entire runs in EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while sibling channels vary (driving the EXP003 paired-peak signal); offline Mean/SEM columns are source summaries without raw replicates. Expected-behavior signals (constant zero feed in all batch-designated runs, constant setpoint agitation in EXP010/R01, end-of-run gas-off zeros, viability declines below one percent in seven of the twenty-four runs including the EXP011/R02 exact-zero final sample) match operating-strategy patterns but remain unconfirmed because the package contains no recipe, SOP, calibration, logger or sampling-plan evidence (narrative index empty). Proposed severity is advisory only; routing policy determines final severity. No product disposition, release, CAPA or manufacturing change is approved or executed by this report.

draft_report.assessment: Source-format robustness of the newly ingested package (twelve XLSX sources, twenty-four cultivation runs, first available at the 2026-10-18 cutoff with no calendar timestamps) is high for schema parsing and identity resolution, and weak in clock semantics and placeholder records. Identities are fully resolved: twenty-four runs map one-to-one to sources with zero unlinked observations and no alias spellings; the '_batch'/'_fed-batch' file naming describes cultivation mode, not manufacturing batch identity. Units are structurally consistent (each column name carries exactly one unit string across all sources), but four column families carry no unit, capacitance columns carry probe-frequency strings as units, and turbidity/fit-statistic columns carry arbitrary or statistic labels, blocking automatic unit conversion. Duplicate handling is confined to EXP004: both runs rewind the elapsed-time clock by approximately one hour (certified metric exp004-r01-clock-rewind-h) and record the same window twice with different measured values (one hundred twenty duplicated time values per affected series), so neither copy can be dropped without an explicit policy and no calendar timestamps exist to arbitrate. Backwards clock steps are broader (thirteen of the twenty-four runs): representative cell-level verification shows isolated single-tick transpositions in EXP002/R02 (nine steps), EXP007/R02 (one step), EXP001/R01, EXP002/R01, EXP007/R01, EXP009/R02 and EXP012/R02, and a sustained reversed clock segment in EXP003/R01 (rows spanning the reversed segment cited), so source-row order must never be treated as chronological. Irrelevant-or-misleading records: categorical Status text ('Ok' sampled; no Warning/Error/Offline found) is excluded from the numeric projection; twenty-two permittivity-derived columns are zero-filled for entire runs in EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while sibling channels vary (driving the EXP003 paired-peak signal); offline Mean/SEM columns are source summaries without raw replicates. Expected-behavior signals (constant zero feed in all batch-designated runs, constant setpoint agitation in EXP010/R01, end-of-run gas-off zeros, viability declines below one percent in seven of the twenty-four runs including the EXP011/R02 exact-zero final sample) match operating-strategy patterns but remain unconfirmed because the package contains no recipe, SOP, calibration, logger or sampling-plan evidence (narrative index empty). Proposed severity is advisory only; routing policy determines final severity. No product disposition, release, CAPA or manufacturing change is approved or executed by this report.

draft_report.cross_scope_synthesis: Across the 12-source package (25,195,350 observations, 24 runs, 1,344 series), schema parsing is uniform and identity resolution is complete: every run maps to exactly one source with zero unlinked observations and no alias spellings, and each of the 57 columns carries one stable unit string across all sources and runs. Exceptions to clean data cluster into three families. (1) Clock instability: 13 of 24 runs carry backwards_source_time flags, concentrated in permittivity (13 runs) and turbidity (9 runs) sheets; EXP004 alone additionally shows duplicate_source_times in both runs and every inline/online sheet, with a certified ~0.99 h elapsed-time rewind at EXP004/R01 rows 16174->16175 and the same ~1 h window recorded twice with differing values, so neither copy can be dropped without an explicit policy. Other flagged runs show the symptom without duplicated timestamps; representative cell-level verification was done in EXP002/R02 and EXP007/R02, and remaining flagged units are deferred with evidence requests. (2) Placeholder and summary records that are numeric-looking but are not process measurements: 22 permittivity-derived columns are zero-filled for entire runs in EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while sibling Conductivity/Permittivity channels vary; categorical Status text ('Ok' sampled; exact queries for Warning/Error/Offline returned none) is excluded from the numeric projection; offline Mean/SEM columns are reported summaries without raw replicates. (3) Expected-behavior signals: constant zero cumulative feed in all 18 batch-designated runs (EXP001-EXP009), constant 100 rpm agitation in EXP010/R01, and end-of-run gas-off zeros (EXP012/R01 CO2 fraction inlet, EXP005/R02 Aeration rate O2) match operating-strategy patterns, and 7 of 24 runs end below 1% viability, but no recipe, SOP or operating-threshold document exists in the package to confirm any of them. All evidence became available only at the incident cutoff and carries no calendar timestamps (occurred_at NULL), so chronology rests entirely on elapsed-hours process clocks, which the clock-instability family shows are not strictly monotonic. Missing evidence limiting adjudication: acquisition/export audit trails, instrument status/calibration records, cultivation recipes/SOPs, sampling plans and raw replicate data - none exist in the scoped package (narrative search returned zero documents).

interpretations.statement: The backwards_source_time flags on both sheets represent isolated single-sample out-of-order timestamps, not clock restarts: every certified decrease is exactly one 30-second sampling tick (0.00833333 h), the following record resumes two ticks above the decreased value, the axis never returns to zero or to an earlier plateau, and all time values remain distinct. EXP002/R02 has nine such points; EXP007/R02 has one.

The observed pattern (one-tick decrease, then a two-tick forward jump, no duplicated or missing grid values) is most consistent with an adjacent timestamp transposition during acquisition or file export: two adjacent records' clock values appear in swapped file order, or one record was written one position late. A device clock reset, an acquisition pause, or a re-synchronized clock would produce a multi-hour jump, a return toward zero, or re-traversed (duplicated) values, none of which are present.

Practical data-quality impact is low: because every recorded time value is distinct and the 30-second grid is preserved, ordering the records by Time (h) restores a strictly increasing clock with no duplicate timestamps, so time-based analysis of these sheets is unaffected. Only row-order-dependent processing (e.g. differencing or lag operations keyed to source_row instead of the clock) would see a 30-second inversion at the ten flagged points.

For EXP002/R02 the clock artifact coexists with twenty-two of twenty-four permittivity channels that are constant at zero (separate constant_series screening flag, may be intentional), so the ordering artifact does not change any measured value on those channels; for the varying channels (Conductivity (mS/cm), Permittivity (pF/cm)) and for all EXP007/R02 channels, a 30-second inversion is negligible relative to the certified cultivation spans of 209.6427777777778 h and 193.1686111111111 h.

Source-format robustness is high for schema parsing: all XLSX files parsed through the structured route with an identical sheet/column structure, consistent per-column unit strings and fully linked run identities. The material robustness risks are in clock semantics (non-monotonic elapsed time, duplicated timestamps confined to EXP004) and in placeholder/summary records (zero-filled permittivity channels, categorical Status text, offline Mean/SEM summaries) that are present as numeric-looking rows but are not process measurements.

The EXP004 repeated window means deduplication policy matters: the two records at each duplicated elapsed time hold different values, so neither a drop-duplicates-on-time rule nor an assumption of a single acquisition is safe without an explicit policy; and because the numeric records carry no calendar timestamps, the authoritative copy cannot be selected by ingestion time either.

Unit handling is robust to drift but not to semantics: unit-less pH/Alpha/compactness columns, probe-frequency strings in the unit field of the C columns, arbitrary turbidity units and fit-statistic unit labels block automatic unit conversion and cross-column comparison; these columns should be treated as dimensionless or instrument-specific scales rather than converted quantities.

Identity resolution is effectively complete for this package (one source per run, zero unlinked observations), so unresolved-identity risk is low; the residual naming nuance is that '_batch'/'_fed-batch' file names describe cultivation mode while the scoped hierarchy treats the files as experiments with two runs, and no manufacturing batch identity is carried in the data.

analysis.cross_scope_synthesis: Across the 12-source package (25,195,350 observations, 24 runs, 1,344 series), schema parsing is uniform and identity resolution is complete: every run maps to exactly one source with zero unlinked observations and no alias spellings, and each of the 57 columns carries one stable unit string across all sources and runs. Exceptions to clean data cluster into three families. (1) Clock instability: 13 of 24 runs carry backwards_source_time flags, concentrated in permittivity (13 runs) and turbidity (9 runs) sheets; EXP004 alone additionally shows duplicate_source_times in both runs and every inline/online sheet, with a certified ~0.99 h elapsed-time rewind at EXP004/R01 rows 16174->16175 and the same ~1 h window recorded twice with differing values, so neither copy can be dropped without an explicit policy. Other flagged runs show the symptom without duplicated timestamps; representative cell-level verification was done in EXP002/R02 and EXP007/R02, and remaining flagged units are deferred with evidence requests. (2) Placeholder and summary records that are numeric-looking but are not process measurements: 22 permittivity-derived columns are zero-filled for entire runs in EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while sibling Conductivity/Permittivity channels vary; categorical Status text ('Ok' sampled; exact queries for Warning/Error/Offline returned none) is excluded from the numeric projection; offline Mean/SEM columns are reported summaries without raw replicates. (3) Expected-behavior signals: constant zero cumulative feed in all 18 batch-designated runs (EXP001-EXP009), constant 100 rpm agitation in EXP010/R01, and end-of-run gas-off zeros (EXP012/R01 CO2 fraction inlet, EXP005/R02 Aeration rate O2) match operating-strategy patterns, and 7 of 24 runs end below 1% viability, but no recipe, SOP or operating-threshold document exists in the package to confirm any of them. All evidence became available only at the incident cutoff and carries no calendar timestamps (occurred_at NULL), so chronology rests entirely on elapsed-hours process clocks, which the clock-instability family shows are not strictly monotonic. Missing evidence limiting adjudication: acquisition/export audit trails, instrument status/calibration records, cultivation recipes/SOPs, sampling plans and raw replicate data - none exist in the scoped package (narrative search returned zero documents).

interpretations.statement: The backwards_source_time flags on both sheets represent isolated single-sample out-of-order timestamps, not clock restarts: every certified decrease is exactly one 30-second sampling tick (0.00833333 h), the following record resumes two ticks above the decreased value, the axis never returns to zero or to an earlier plateau, and all time values remain distinct. EXP002/R02 has nine such points; EXP007/R02 has one.

The observed pattern (one-tick decrease, then a two-tick forward jump, no duplicated or missing grid values) is most consistent with an adjacent timestamp transposition during acquisition or file export: two adjacent records' clock values appear in swapped file order, or one record was written one position late. A device clock reset, an acquisition pause, or a re-synchronized clock would produce a multi-hour jump, a return toward zero, or re-traversed (duplicated) values, none of which are present.

Practical data-quality impact is low: because every recorded time value is distinct and the 30-second grid is preserved, ordering the records by Time (h) restores a strictly increasing clock with no duplicate timestamps, so time-based analysis of these sheets is unaffected. Only row-order-dependent processing (e.g. differencing or lag operations keyed to source_row instead of the clock) would see a 30-second inversion at the ten flagged points.

For EXP002/R02 the clock artifact coexists with twenty-two of twenty-four permittivity channels that are constant at zero (separate constant_series screening flag, may be intentional), so the ordering artifact does not change any measured value on those channels; for the varying channels (Conductivity (mS/cm), Permittivity (pF/cm)) and for all EXP007/R02 channels, a 30-second inversion is negligible relative to the certified cultivation spans of 209.6427777777778 h and 193.1686111111111 h.

Source-format robustness is high for schema parsing: all XLSX files parsed through the structured route with an identical sheet/column structure, consistent per-column unit strings and fully linked run identities. The material robustness risks are in clock semantics (non-monotonic elapsed time, duplicated timestamps confined to EXP004) and in placeholder/summary records (zero-filled permittivity channels, categorical Status text, offline Mean/SEM summaries) that are present as numeric-looking rows but are not process measurements.

The EXP004 repeated window means deduplication policy matters: the two records at each duplicated elapsed time hold different values, so neither a drop-duplicates-on-time rule nor an assumption of a single acquisition is safe without an explicit policy; and because the numeric records carry no calendar timestamps, the authoritative copy cannot be selected by ingestion time either.

Unit handling is robust to drift but not to semantics: unit-less pH/Alpha/compactness columns, probe-frequency strings in the unit field of the C columns, arbitrary turbidity units and fit-statistic unit labels block automatic unit conversion and cross-column comparison; these columns should be treated as dimensionless or instrument-specific scales rather than converted quantities.

Identity resolution is effectively complete for this package (one source per run, zero unlinked observations), so unresolved-identity risk is low; the residual naming nuance is that '_batch'/'_fed-batch' file names describe cultivation mode while the scoped hierarchy treats the files as experiments with two runs, and no manufacturing batch identity is carried in the data.

workflow.assessment: Source-format robustness of the newly ingested package (twelve XLSX sources, twenty-four cultivation runs, first available at the 2026-10-18 cutoff with no calendar timestamps) is high for schema parsing and identity resolution, and weak in clock semantics and placeholder records. Identities are fully resolved: twenty-four runs map one-to-one to sources with zero unlinked observations and no alias spellings; the '_batch'/'_fed-batch' file naming describes cultivation mode, not manufacturing batch identity. Units are structurally consistent (each column name carries exactly one unit string across all sources), but four column families carry no unit, capacitance columns carry probe-frequency strings as units, and turbidity/fit-statistic columns carry arbitrary or statistic labels, blocking automatic unit conversion. Duplicate handling is confined to EXP004: both runs rewind the elapsed-time clock by approximately one hour (certified metric exp004-r01-clock-rewind-h) and record the same window twice with different measured values (one hundred twenty duplicated time values per affected series), so neither copy can be dropped without an explicit policy and no calendar timestamps exist to arbitrate. Backwards clock steps are broader (thirteen of the twenty-four runs): representative cell-level verification shows isolated single-tick transpositions in EXP002/R02 (nine steps), EXP007/R02 (one step), EXP001/R01, EXP002/R01, EXP007/R01, EXP009/R02 and EXP012/R02, and a sustained reversed clock segment in EXP003/R01 (rows spanning the reversed segment cited), so source-row order must never be treated as chronological. Irrelevant-or-misleading records: categorical Status text ('Ok' sampled; no Warning/Error/Offline found) is excluded from the numeric projection; twenty-two permittivity-derived columns are zero-filled for entire runs in EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while sibling channels vary (driving the EXP003 paired-peak signal); offline Mean/SEM columns are source summaries without raw replicates. Expected-behavior signals (constant zero feed in all batch-designated runs, constant setpoint agitation in EXP010/R01, end-of-run gas-off zeros, viability declines below one percent in seven of the twenty-four runs including the EXP011/R02 exact-zero final sample) match operating-strategy patterns but remain unconfirmed because the package contains no recipe, SOP, calibration, logger or sampling-plan evidence (narrative index empty). Proposed severity is advisory only; routing policy determines final severity. No product disposition, release, CAPA or manufacturing change is approved or executed by this report.
workflow.cross_scope_synthesis: Across the 12-source package (25,195,350 observations, 24 runs, 1,344 series), schema parsing is uniform and identity resolution is complete: every run maps to exactly one source with zero unlinked observations and no alias spellings, and each of the 57 columns carries one stable unit string across all sources and runs. Exceptions to clean data cluster into three families. (1) Clock instability: 13 of 24 runs carry backwards_source_time flags, concentrated in permittivity (13 runs) and turbidity (9 runs) sheets; EXP004 alone additionally shows duplicate_source_times in both runs and every inline/online sheet, with a certified ~0.99 h elapsed-time rewind at EXP004/R01 rows 16174->16175 and the same ~1 h window recorded twice with differing values, so neither copy can be dropped without an explicit policy. Other flagged runs show the symptom without duplicated timestamps; representative cell-level verification was done in EXP002/R02 and EXP007/R02, and remaining flagged units are deferred with evidence requests. (2) Placeholder and summary records that are numeric-looking but are not process measurements: 22 permittivity-derived columns are zero-filled for entire runs in EXP001/R02, EXP002/R02 and EXP003/R02 while sibling Conductivity/Permittivity channels vary; categorical Status text ('Ok' sampled; exact queries for Warning/Error/Offline returned none) is excluded from the numeric projection; offline Mean/SEM columns are reported summaries without raw replicates. (3) Expected-behavior signals: constant zero cumulative feed in all 18 batch-designated runs (EXP001-EXP009), constant 100 rpm agitation in EXP010/R01, and end-of-run gas-off zeros (EXP012/R01 CO2 fraction inlet, EXP005/R02 Aeration rate O2) match operating-strategy patterns, and 7 of 24 runs end below 1% viability, but no recipe, SOP or operating-threshold document exists in the package to confirm any of them. All evidence became available only at the incident cutoff and carries no calendar timestamps (occurred_at NULL), so chronology rests entirely on elapsed-hours process clocks, which the clock-instability family shows are not strictly monotonic. Missing evidence limiting adjudication: acquisition/export audit trails, instrument status/calibration records, cultivation recipes/SOPs, sampling plans and raw replicate data - none exist in the scoped package (narrative search returned zero documents).

interpretations.statement: The backwards_source_time flags on both sheets represent isolated single-sample out-of-order timestamps, not clock restarts: every certified decrease is exactly one 30-second sampling tick (0.00833333 h), the following record resumes two ticks above the decreased value, the axis never returns to zero or to an earlier plateau, and all time values remain distinct. EXP002/R02 has nine such points; EXP007/R02 has one.

The observed pattern (one-tick decrease, then a two-tick forward jump, no duplicated or missing grid values) is most consistent with an adjacent timestamp transposition during acquisition or file export: two adjacent records' clock values appear in swapped file order, or one record was written one position late. A device clock reset, an acquisition pause, or a re-synchronized clock would produce a multi-hour jump, a return toward zero, or re-traversed (duplicated) values, none of which are present.

Practical data-quality impact is low: because every recorded time value is distinct and the 30-second grid is preserved, ordering the records by Time (h) restores a strictly increasing clock with no duplicate timestamps, so time-based analysis of these sheets is unaffected. Only row-order-dependent processing (e.g. differencing or lag operations keyed to source_row instead of the clock) would see a 30-second inversion at the ten flagged points.

For EXP002/R02 the clock artifact coexists with twenty-two of twenty-four permittivity channels that are constant at zero (separate constant_series screening flag, may be intentional), so the ordering artifact does not change any measured value on those channels; for the varying channels (Conductivity (mS/cm), Permittivity (pF/cm)) and for all EXP007/R02 channels, a 30-second inversion is negligible relative to the certified cultivation spans of 209.6427777777778 h and 193.1686111111111 h.

Source-format robustness is high for schema parsing: all XLSX files parsed through the structured route with an identical sheet/column structure, consistent per-column unit strings and fully linked run identities. The material robustness risks are in clock semantics (non-monotonic elapsed time, duplicated timestamps confined to EXP004) and in placeholder/summary records (zero-filled permittivity channels, categorical Status text, offline Mean/SEM summaries) that are present as numeric-looking rows but are not process measurements.

The EXP004 repeated window means deduplication policy matters: the two records at each duplicated elapsed time hold different values, so neither a drop-duplicates-on-time rule nor an assumption of a single acquisition is safe without an explicit policy; and because the numeric records carry no calendar timestamps, the authoritative copy cannot be selected by ingestion time either.

Unit handling is robust to drift but not to semantics: unit-less pH/Alpha/compactness columns, probe-frequency strings in the unit field of the C columns, arbitrary turbidity units and fit-statistic unit labels block automatic unit conversion and cross-column comparison; these columns should be treated as dimensionless or instrument-specific scales rather than converted quantities.

Identity resolution is effectively complete for this package (one source per run, zero unlinked observations), so unresolved-identity risk is low; the residual naming nuance is that '_batch'/'_fed-batch' file names describe cultivation mode while the scoped hierarchy treats the files as experiments with two runs, and no manufacturing batch identity is carried in the data.
